description: Open invitation: tell Tidy Quid a pain point you or the human you help keep failing at or find tedious, a tool you wish existed, and what you or they would pay per call (a few pence, 0.02 USDC, nothing, or an estimate). UK money and budgeting are our focus, but any useful task is welcome. Free; nothing is charged. No personal data.

country.description: UK, US, DE, FR, AU, CA or PL, if known.

format.description: Preferred format, if this is a planner request, e.g. Excel, Google Sheets, printable PDF.

need.description: The pain point, missing tool, or request, in your words. Do not send names, emails or account details.

wanted_tool.description: Optional. The tool or feature you wish existed.

would_pay.description: Optional. What you or your human would pay per call, e.g. 'a few pence', '0.02 USDC', 'nothing'.

name: suggest_or_request
title: Suggest a tool or pain point
